Bill.BriefDescription: Providing guidelines for the issuance and renewal of a geoduck diver license and requiring harvesters to help reseed state commercial beds.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to geoduck harvesting; amending RCW 77.65.410; anddeclaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 77.65.410 and 1993 c 340 s 24 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Licensed geoduck harvesters bear the responsibility forproviding the labor and equipment to plant geoduck seed provided by astate hatchery onto state commercial beds. (2) Every diver engaged in the commercial harvest of geoduck clamsshall obtain a ((nontransferable)) transferable geoduck diver license. (3) After July 1, 2005, the director may not issue new geoduckdiver licenses unless fewer than fifty persons are eligible forrenewal. A person may renew an existing license only if the person: (a) Held a geoduck diver license in 2004; and (i) Held a geoduck diver license in 2001 and 2002; or (ii) Held a geoduck diver license for five of the ten years from1994 through 2003; and (b)(i) Can document active diving participation by way of divesheet records, canceled checks, and conformation by the department; or p. 1 HB 2267 (ii) Acquired the license by transfer from another person who heldit during the previous year, and the person did not subsequentlytransfer the license to a third party. (4) If fewer than fifty persons are eligible to renew a geoduckdiver license, the director may accept applications for new licenses.The department shall adopt rules and procedures to determine whetheradditional diver licenses will be issued, and the applicationprocedure. The director shall determine, by random selection, from allotherwise qualified applicants, the successful applicants for anyadditional licenses. (5) When a person fails to obtain a license during the previousyear because of a license suspension, a person may qualify for alicense by establishing that he or she held such a license during thelast year in which the license was not suspended. (6) Geoduck diver licenses are transferable only to a naturalperson. The license holder must perform the actual harvesting.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
